result.description: API-first customer support platform for B2B teams (threads, customers, workflows, SLAs, help center, AI agents).
result.auth_detail: Workspace API keys (tied to machine users, fine-grained permissions) sent as Authorization: Bearer. No third-party OAuth app flow documented for the GraphQL API; hosted MCP uses OAuth for individual users only.
result.access_detail: Keys are created in a Plain workspace (Settings → API Keys / Machine Users). Pricing lists API under 'Developer platform'; 7-day no-card free trial, then paid per-seat plans (Foundation ~$45/user/mo billed annually). Not confirmed whether API is on every plan; no free tier found. Each end user would supply their own workspace key.
result.api_notes: Single GraphQL endpoint https://core-api.uk.plain.com/graphql/v1 (POST only) with public schema; Plain's own app is built on it. TypeScript SDK, webhooks and events also available.

evidence.quote: Plain itself is built on this same GraphQL API.
You authenticate with your existing Plain account, so the MCP server has the same permissions as your user.
Foundation is $45/user/month, Horizon is $99/user/month, and Frontier is custom.
